post.news: Apple brought back the glowing logo on its new MacBook Pro and finally added touch screens.
post.take: Apple spent years telling us touch screens on laptops were dumb, until it needed a new feature to sell.
post.insight: Tech brands love to call features impossible until sales slow down and they need a fresh upgrade cycle.
